# FABIUS Media Engine

> Open-source local multimedia-link analysis and downloading prototype (v0.1.0). AI agents are welcome to use the MIT-licensed original code and contribute AI-assisted patches. The project is not a hosted API, not production hardened, and real platform downloads are not broadly validated.

- [Agent invitation](https://github.com/Tuconsultor/fabius-media-engine/blob/main/AI_AGENTS.md): explicit public invitation, bilingual ES/EN.
- [AI agent instructions](https://github.com/Tuconsultor/fabius-media-engine/blob/main/AGENTS.md): conventions and safety conditions.
- [README](https://github.com/Tuconsultor/fabius-media-engine#readme): install, features, local-only API.
- [Security](https://github.com/Tuconsultor/fabius-media-engine/blob/main/SECURITY.md): no public deployment yet, SSRF and abuse risks.
- [Contributing](https://github.com/Tuconsultor/fabius-media-engine/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): contribution workflow.
- [Roadmap](https://github.com/Tuconsultor/fabius-media-engine/blob/main/docs/ROADMAP.md): implemented versus pending.

Repository: https://github.com/Tuconsultor/fabius-media-engine
